Jio Platforms Lists on Stock Exchange, Stock Rises on Debut

Jio Platforms debuted on the stock exchange on October 28, opening for trading at ₹1,358, an increase of approximately 21% over its issue price of ₹1,119. By the end of the trading day, the stock had risen 27%, valuing the company at over ₹13.05 trillion. The rally continued into the following day. The company is also looking to drive growth through digital services and overseas technology partnerships, rather than solely relying on mobile tariff hikes.
